measured_rules: Path lookup precedes version and output validation.
Versions 0, 1, 4 and -1 return EINVAL after successful lookup.
Paths accept at most 1023 bytes plus NUL; longer input returns IRIX ENAMETOOLONG 78.
Symlinks are followed; trailing slash on a file is accepted.
Native search permission applies; file read permission is unnecessary.
A copy crossing an inaccessible page writes the accessible prefix then returns EFAULT.
All reserved fields and structure padding are zero.
The o32 version-2 size field saturates at INT32_MAX.
Device encoding has 14 major bits above 18 minor bits.
The v1 sentinel and tested n32 saved register survive the call.
native_differences: Device/inode identity, directory size, timestamps and allocation reflect the native filesystem, checked using an independent stat observer.
Filesystem name is unknown rather than xfs; project ID is zero because project accounting is not implemented.
Absolute paths use /emul/irix with native-path fallback, as with existing foreign file operations.
unqualified: Other historical version selectors beyond the tested rejected values
Inode, block-count, timestamp or device values beyond the encoded widths
IRIX project accounting and XFS attributes
Concurrent namespace mutation and foreign signal interruption
General IRIX application or desktop compatibility
